decisions.reason: The all-field label rule does not change how placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
Requiring matching help labels does not alter the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting.
The new label-content rule does not resolve or replace the separate unresolved choice of a visual cue mechanism for fillable fields.
Matching each label to its field's initial prompt does not change the mechanism used to implement robust text placeholders.
The checklist remains the required control type; its applicable help label is governed independently by the source Requirement.
The source decision does not alter the dropdown control type or its Bestyrelsesmode document context.
The calendar-style date input method remains unchanged; label requirements are represented by the separate source Requirement.
The reference to labels for interactive fields is unrelated to bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, or variants.
Interactive-field label content does not change the constraint that pasted content remain within column boundaries.
The source decision does not affect table layout stability or right-column boundaries during paste operations.
Historical co-mention of labels and theme colors does not make the new interactive-field label rule a theme-palette change.
Although the client mentions a translated version, the message does not change the document default language, content language, or style-name language.
